feeding_claim.verbatim: Our beef is 100% grass-fed and grass-finished.

resold_note: Also sells beef, chicken and pork from named partner farms, plus lamb, bison, eggs, dairy, seafood and groceries whose source farms the site does not name.
notes: Large online meat business with a 500-acre farm and farm store at Roanoke. Read the homepage, our story, our standards (protocols), farm partners, home delivery, farm store and grass-fed beef store pages (WebFetch summaries only, so the verbatim quote should be rechecked on the page). The beef page says the cattle graze on the Indiana farm and on vetted partner farms, so the farm raises some but not all of its beef. The site never says which other products come from its own land; the farm partners page names outside farms for beef, chicken and pork, and eggs go through a sister company, FreshEggCo. Only beef is listed as raised here; the rest is in resold_note. Partner standards page says cattle are never fed grain and get hay in winter; pork is supplemented with corn and soy feed. Delivery FAQ: 'We deliver all across the USA, except for Hawaii and Alaska', by local courier in its service area and UPS elsewhere; homepage names home delivery in Chicago, Indianapolis and Fort Wayne. Pickup at the Indiana farm store. Sells a 1/8 beef box bundle but no quarter, half or whole shares found. Farm store phone 260-298-5299; online orders 877-620-1977. Farm store hours conflict between page body and meta description. Steak and roast categories did not load, so cut list is partial. The first fetch of the homepage was blocked; later fetches worked.
